name: Dasbo Island
description:
Live Claude Code and Codex sessions in the top bar: status, one click back to the terminal, and Claude Code permission prompts answered inline.

Preferences can add hook entries to ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.codex/hooks.json; this happens only when you press Install hooks. A .dasbo.bak copy is written before the first change, and Remove hooks takes the entries back out again. The hook itself is hooks/dasbo-hook, a readable GJS script that the agent runs, not the extension. ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json is reserved for Antigravity support, not enabled in this build.
